item.title: Cost of Living in Craigieburn Melbourne
item.description:
Money matters when you’re choosing where to live. Here’s the real story on costs in Craigieburn — no sugar-coating, no made-up figures.

Read our full Craigieburn suburb guide for the bigger picture.

Is Craigieburn Expensive?

Craigieburn sits somewhere in the middle of Melbourne’s cost spectrum. It’s not cheap, but it’s not going to break the bank either — assuming you’re realistic about expectations.

The cost of living here reflects what the suburb offers. Location, community, access to amenities — you get what you pay for, and in Craigieburn, you’re generally getting good value for the price point.

item.title: Craigieburn — History and How It's Changed
item.description:
Every Melbourne suburb has a story. Craigieburn’s story is one of farmland and orchards that became suburban housing in the post-war boom. Understanding that history explains why the suburb feels the way it does today.

See our full Craigieburn suburb guide for the current picture.

What Craigieburn Was Originally

Before it was what you see today, Craigieburn was agricultural land and market gardens. The original residents built the suburb’s foundation — the street grid, the housing stock, the community institutions that still exist in some form.

item.title: Craigieburn Neighbourhood Guide — Streets and Pockets
item.description:
